title: rich summary record (v1)
description: The terminal record of a successful rich callback lookup: the number of vertical blocks the response carried (the result records emitted), the total items across them, the exchange status, and the request identifiers the response offered. Rate-limit windows and usage stay in the JSON envelope's meta, not in JSONL records, so every line stays lean and independently parseable.

result_count.$comment: The vertical blocks enumerated, one per result record emitted.

item_count.$comment: The total items across every vertical block.
